items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 4 at 2:29PM AKDT until May 5 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph expected.

* WHERE...Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...From 1 PM to 10 PM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued May 4 at 2:25PM AKDT until May 7 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow and blowing snow expected. Total snow accumulations up
to two inches. Winds gusting as high as 40 mph.

* WHERE...Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast.

* WHEN...From 4 AM Tuesday to 4 AM AKDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Areas of blowing snow could
reduce visibility to as low as a half mile at times.
items.instruction: Slow down and use caution while traveling.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued May 4 at 2:24PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
As a front pushes across the Brooks Range, snow totals of around 4
to 7 inches will be possible across the Central Arctic Coast,
especially between Utqiagvik and Nuiqsut, and the Central Arctic
Plains. The highest snowfall rates are likely to occur from
Tuesday night through Wednesday morning. Along the Dalton Highway,

items.description:

* IMPACTS...Flooding low-lying and flood-prone locations is imminent

especially near Fish Creek. Additional rain showers Monday

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 3 at 4:26PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
